sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-20 and 2016-12-20, internal automated monitoring identified suspicious transaction activity on card C13171-K2 belonging to customer C13171. Flagged transaction 3558054 in the amount of $55.68 was executed via undocumented. The transaction was initiated from an unrecognized device ( |  | chrome 66.0 | ). Cross-account analysis revealed this device fingerprint is concurrently linked to multiple cardholder accounts (C08106-K1, C11891-K1), indicating organized multi-card harvesting or syndicate involvement. Cardholder was contacted and explicitly denied authorizing the charge while confirming physical possession of the card. Historical case memory retrieved relevant precedents (CC-4124, CC-4086) with confirmed fraud typologies. The financial institution has initiated preventive containment including card blocking and heightened monitoring of linked accounts. Total suspicious activity identified amounts to $55.68. This report is filed pursuant to regulatory requirements under Rule R2/R6.

stop_reason: Graph pattern and customer validation definitively confirmed unauthorized compromise. Containment actions established.
